currentFindings.evidence: The first opening had two superseded attempts and then full pagination succeeded at23:00:16.434. A later opening at23:04:23 was counted as attempt3 despite intervening success.
currentFindings.rootCause: CoreTextPageEngine reported every awaiting caller against a shared nil-book bucket and never cleared that bucket after full layout. ReaderViewModel clears a different real-book bucket.

currentFindings.impact: A directory refresh failed. The observed cached chapter was still laid out; successful online source refresh is not established.

correctionRequirements: Scope layout retry history to the real engine instance and book without changing ordinary content-fetch retry ownership.
Count an actual discarded pending task once, rather than counting each awaiting caller.
Clear only that scope after an accepted complete nonempty layout, before the ready callback. A late old task must not clear or refill a newer run.
Keep genuine repeated-layout anomalies and the existing bounded history; do not hide errors or add timing waits.

behavior: Existing bounded retry history accepts an optional owner scope; ordinary fetch/download callers keep their prior keys and behavior.
A CoreText pagination engine uses its actual current book identity and one engine UUID. Different engines and content fetch retries do not share this run.
The existing generation-discard owner records each pending task once before clearing the existing task dictionaries; awaiting callers no longer increment the same retry again.
An accepted complete readable document clears only this layout scope before layout/snapshot/ready callbacks. Old awaiting tasks do not write or clear newer diagnostic history.
The existing anomaly threshold is unchanged. Repeated unresolved work can still produce an anomaly.
implementation.review: Root inspected both production diffs, two existing test diffs and actual publication/generation call sites. SDK harness author independently checked fixture joiner signaling and selected API visibility.

newRegressionDefinitions.purpose: Recovering one layout owner leaves fetch retries and another engine history untouched.
Three unrecovered layout discards still report, and recovery rearms the threshold.
Actual gated engine work with three signalled joiners is counted once; successful pagination clears its own run while fetch retries survive.
Two actual engines for the same book have independent pending-work runs and recover independently.
A synchronous ready callback sees recovery, does not count the full completing task as discarded, and its newly recorded retry is not cleared by the old awaiter return.
